trace.command: export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg --version || npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz; noacg --version; mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done) </dev/null; echo certs $?; noacg doctor

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p /workspace && cd /workspace && rm -rf graphic && noacg scaffold --type now-next --design neutral --out /workspace/graphic 2>&1 | tail -20; ls -R graphic | head -40; cd graphic; cat *.html; cat css/template.css; wc -l js/template.js

cd /workspace/graphic; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; mkdir -p /mnt/session/outputs; noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json 2>&1 | tail -3; sed -i 's/font-size: calc(22px \* var(--scale) \* var(--type-scale));/font-size: calc(24px * var(--scale) * var(--type-scale));/' css/template.css; sed -i 's/letter-spacing: 0.14em;/letter-spacing: 0.12em;/' css/template.css; noacg validate /workspace/graphic --screenshots /workspace/shots 2>&1 | grep -E "OK|FAIL|ERROR|WARN"

cd /workspace/graphic; sed -i 's/"ftype": "textarea"/"ftype": "textfield"/g' now_next_library_conference.html; export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio; noacg validate /workspace/graphic --screenshots /workspace/shots 2>&1 | grep -E "OK|FAIL|ERROR|WARN" && noacg record /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/record.json 2>&1 | tail -1; noacg coverage /workspace/graphic --out /mnt/session/outputs/coverage 2>&1 | tail -8; cat /mnt/session/outputs/coverage/coverage.json | head -60
